Get list sizes and prescribing units from OpenPrescribing

Source: R/openprescribing.R
get_op_org_details.Rd

Monthly organisation statistics from the OpenPrescribing org_details endpoint, mainly the registered patient list size used as a denominator for prescribing rates. get_op_spending can add these for you with add_list_size = TRUE.

Usage

get_op_org_details(
  resolution = "england",
  org = NULL,
  keys = "total_list_size",
  date = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  end = NULL,
  as_data_table = FALSE
)

Arguments

resolution, org, date, start, end, as_data_table

as for get_op_spending. Without org, every organisation at the resolution is returned for the whole five-year window, which is a large download at "practice" level.

keys

character vector of statistics to return: "total_list_size", "astro_pu_items", "astro_pu_cost" or any "star_pu.<name>" key listed in the OpenPrescribing API documentation.

Value

A data.frame with columns date, resolution, org_id, org_name and one column per requested key (STAR-PU keys appear as star_pu.<name>).

Examples

# \donttest{
get_op_org_details("icb", keys = "total_list_size", start = "2024-01", end = "2024-03")
#> Error: OpenPrescribing refused the request (HTTP 403, a bot-protection challenge), so no data could be retrieved from /org_details/.
#> This is applied by the service to some networks and clients (for example some cloud or institutional IP ranges). Try again later or from another network, and consider reducing the request rate with options(ukhsadatR.requests_per_second = 0.5).
# }
